name: exploit a misconfigured sudo rule to run a privileged command
definition: Invoke an allowed binary through the privilege-elevation mechanism in a way that grants the needed capability.
failure_mode: Using a disallowed command or failing elevation leaves the file intact.

name: expose required entry-point functions under required names
definition: define the sampler and a self-test routine with the exact names the verifier looks for by regex in the R source.
failure_mode: naming/format variation means the verifier's regex does not match

name: expose the recovered key as a 32-bit unsigned value through the required calling convention
definition: Return the exact unsigned 32-bit subkey from the module so the driver test can compare to the reference.
failure_mode: Signed/wrapped or wrong-width output breaks the equality.

name: extract the weight matrix of a relu mlp from forward queries
definition: recover an unknown linear input layer of a one-hidden-layer ReLU network by strategically querying the scalar forward function.
failure_mode: insufficient or non-independent queries fail to separate the linear regions, so rows do not align
